notes:
IDENTITY CONFIRMED ON THREE ASSIGNED FACTS - name, sub-specialty and hospital - from a single official source. A domain-restricted WebSearch against aighospitals.com for the name plus 'liver transplant anaesthesia' returned https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-s-vijaya-kumar with the title 'Dr. S Vijaya Kumar', and the indexed page content identifies him as an Associate Consultant in liver transplant anaesthesia at AIG Hospital Gachibowli who manages liver transplant anaesthesia and pre/post-operative ICU care and independently handles both paediatric and adult liver transplant anaesthesia. That single result carries name + specialty + hospital + city together, satisfying the section 2 two-fact test several times over. AIG spells the name 'Dr. S Vijaya Kumar' (no full stop after the S) versus 'Dr. S. Vijaya Kumar' in the workbook - a punctuation-only difference, not a different person.

SLUG TRUSTED OVER TITLE, per the AIG method. The recorded URL sits in AIG's canonical singular /doctor/<dr-name-slug> family and its slug, dr-s-vijaya-kumar, matches the assigned name exactly, so the AIG title/URL mismatch trap does not bite here. The page is live - it was NOT returned with a '404 Page Not Found' title. No plural /doctors/ or /doctor-profile/ page for him surfaced, and none was constructed. No translate.goog mirror was needed; the canonical host indexed directly.

SAME-NAME DISAMBIGUATION. 'Vijaya Kumar' is a very common South Indian name, so the sub-specialty was required to match explicitly and it does. Deliberately NOT merged: Dr. Kalyan Vijay Kumar, a different AIG doctor whose page https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-kalyan-vijay-kumar surfaced in the same result set - different given name, different slug, nothing from that page was used.

CONTACT STATUS: no email address, no phone number, no WhatsApp and no secretary line is published for him anywhere that surfaced. AIG does not publish per-doctor direct lines on its profile pages as a matter of house style, so this is the expected result rather than a search failure. professional_email and professional_phone are blank rather than guessed, and no address was pattern-derived from the aighospitals.com domain. The pipeline's automatic AIG hospital-level fallback from state/hospital_contacts.json is the correct switchboard route.

BAND IS MEDIUM: exactly one official source (aighospitals.com, the hospital's own site). Per section 5 that is one source, so High is not available. A healinindia.gov.in check was not run for this row on explicit pacing instruction - hospital-employed transplant sub-specialists at Associate Consultant grade are rarely carried in the government Advantage Healthcare directory, which lists senior/marquee consultants. A human wanting High should try that directory. Evidence of identity is nonetheless strong and internally consistent, so this is Enriched, not Needs Human Review.
